description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for the 'git show' command, utilizing a testing library (test-lib.sh). It sets up various git objects and states, then checks the output of 'git show' under different scenarios to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, disables failure if commands pass.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs the provided command expecting it to fail.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit with specific parameters in the test repository.

methods.name: test_merge
methods.description: Merges specified branches or commits within the test repository.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares actual and expected output files or strings.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Signals the end of the test script execution.
